values.note: Rusk County Parks: camping $30 a night at all four county campgrounds. Each RV or camping unit on a site pays the fee; at most 6 people a site unless all are family.

fees.source: https://parks.ruskcounty.org/parks/ ('CAMPING FEES $30.00 per night.') + audie_campground_rules_and_regulations.pdf ('Each RV or camping unit occupying a campsite must pay the required fee.'; 'A maximum of 6 persons per site. The only exception to this rule is if all campers are family members.'), read 2026-11-16

hookups.source: https://parks.ruskcounty.org/parks/camping/audie_lake_campground/ ('One electric pedestal serves two campsites... One 30-amp and one 20-amp outlet on each pedestal. Electricity remains on year-round') + every per-site page site_1..site_15 ('Electric?: Yes', 'Water?: No'), read 2026-11-16

values.note: 15 sites, all with shared electric. Posted pads run 34-95 ft by 14 ft (site 7 is 34 ft, the rest 50 ft or more), so every site takes a 23-ft rig. One pedestal between each pair of sites: an extension cord may be needed.

sites.source: https://parks.ruskcounty.org/parks/camping/audie_lake_campground/site_1/ ... site_15/ ('Dimensions: RV Pad 50' X 14'' ... site 2 'RV Parking 95' X 14'', site 7 'RV Parking 34' X 14''), read 2026-11-16

values.note: Water at a well near the restrooms, turned off from about the second week of October to late April. Nearest dump: the Cenex in Weyerhaeuser or Rice Lake.

facilities.source: https://parks.ruskcounty.org/parks/camping/audie_lake_campground/ ('RV Dump stations are not available at the Audie Lake campground. Please utilize the Cenex gas station in Weyerhauser or Rice Lake.'; 'water gets turned off around the second week of October') + campground map (Well, Restrooms) + alert 635545b66fbe ('Water will be turned back on late April'), read 2026-11-16

values.note: Open year-round; water off in winter and sites are not plowed.

season.source: https://parks.ruskcounty.org/parks/ ('Rusk County Campgrounds are open year-round.'; 'CAMP SITES ARE NOT PLOWED DURING WINTER.'), read 2026-11-16

values.note: Rusk County's own reservation site (Konect Parks). Reservations close 7 days before arrival; any site not reserved is first-come for that date. Only the current calendar year can be booked; next year's dates open January 1. Paid in full when booked, no refunds.

booking.source: https://parks.ruskcounty.org/parks/ ('All reservations must be made 7 days ahead of time. Any camping site that is not reserved ... will then be a first-come, first-serve sight for that date. Reservations are only available for the current calendar year. Reservations for the following year will open on January 1st of that year.') + book_now page ('Sorry, you may only book for the current calendar year'), read 2026-11-16

note: Rusk County Parks campground in the Rusk County Forest on the man-made Audie Flowage, about 12 mi NW of Bruce and half a mile from Perch Lake Campground. Sites 10-15 back toward the flowage, with the water through the trees. ATVs and UTVs are not allowed in the campground; there is a designated ATV parking lot. --Claude
summary: Rusk County Parks pages read: $30/night (new; none stored), 15 sites with shared 30A/20A pedestals and no water at the sites, pads 34-95 ft, well water seasonal, no dump, open year-round, reservable on the county's Konect site up to 7 days ahead and first-come after that. Lakefront -> lakeview proposed (sites 10-15 look at the flowage through woods; continuous canopy to the shore). Phone confirmed.
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront -> lakeview (proposed downgrade). The county map draws sites 9-15 as spurs pointing at Audie Lake, and the official per-site photos (parks.ruskcounty.org/parks/i/ii/l__a10.jpg ... l__a15.jpg) show the water at the end of the spurs of sites 10, 11, 12, 13 and 15 - but always through standing woods: open understory under a continuous canopy, which Esri and USGS imagery show running unbroken from the camp road to the shoreline (around 45.5505,-91.4300). No site sits on open ground at the water. Site 10's photo is the most open (lake and a table ~20-30 m past the spur, trees between). All 15 sites are sold by the night (county reservations / first-come). Under the canopy rule this is a filtered view: lakeview, sites 10-15.

PIN: imagery is canopy-blind; the stored pin 45.5502,-91.4284 lies on Perch Lake Rd beside the camp road and ~100-150 m east of the shore, consistent with the map's layout (boat landing ~180 m SW at ~45.5490,-91.4297). Not moved: the loop can't be seen on imagery.

PHONE confirmed: (715) 532-2113 on every Rusk County Parks page. WEBSITE: the second line https://ruskcountywi.com/audie-lake-perch-lake-campgroundsparks/ answered a Cloudflare challenge ('Just a moment...') - unread, not retried; the parks.ruskcounty.org page is the operator's campground page.

OHV: a 'designated ATV parking lot' at the campground; the rules PDF says ATV/UTVs 'are prohibited in Audie, Josie Creek, and Murphy Campgrounds' (allowed only at Perch Lake). General campground with an ATV side - stays.

LEAD (not vetted): Rusk County's Perch Lake Campground (15 sites, https://parks.ruskcounty.org/parks/camping/perch_lake_campground/, half a mile from Audie on Perch Lake Rd; ATVs allowed in it) and Murphy Campground (same county reservation site) are not in campgrounds.json (the DB's 'Perch Lake Campground' 3347 is a federal one at 46.40,-91.27). Josie Creek County Park 3580 is already in.
